what: The mechanical dispatcher (mcp/agent_dispatch.py, switched on in Kalmido: GET /api/v1/agent runtime.dispatch dry | on, or KALMIDO_DISPATCH on the computer): every interval_min the runner works the lists of KALMIDO-DISPATCH.json in the project folder off without a model deciding: one state per task (built = a commit with #ID in close_ref, in a job, on a branch, held, waiting for a yes on a one-way step, stuck after max_bundles bundles (2.1368.0, #4069: max_tries jobs per bundle, then back to the list with a comment), ready), built tasks are closed with a comment naming the commit, a free place (places) starts ONE job with agent_job.py for the next bundle (priority order, sizes S / M / L as points), jobs without progress for stale_h hours and tasks left open are findings told once in the chat, one day report at report_at; brakes: a stop file, the usage limit, the work window, the jam brake (2.1368.0, #4060: more tasks on a branch than stau_max); a dry run (dry) writes nothing and lists what it would do in the day report and dispatch-dry.log; 2.1368.0 (#7028): check_cmd is required, every job has its own working copy and ends in a pull request -- the dispatcher runs the check on the ended job's branch itself, red = no pull request and the tasks go back to the list, green = it pushes job/<id> only and opens ONE pull request (pr_cmd) with an approval card (merge_request), never a merge or deploy. 2.1394.0 (#5200): a task whose dependency field (task_deps: GET /tasks/<id>/dependencies blocked_by) names an open task not built yet (no commit in close_ref), or one the agent cannot see, is held; the day report (dispatch_waiting) and the dry log name it under waiting; a text line (Grundlage: #ID) is no dependency. 2.1394.0 (#5201): a task the dispatcher closed for a commit and a person reopened keeps its bundle (held, not closed or bundled again, told once with dispatch_reopened); a new commit naming it closes it. 2.1394.0 (#6176): same_file (KALMIDO-DISPATCH.json, default off): ready tasks naming a file of the bundle's first task (paths in title / description) join its bundle (same priority class, bundle_points / bundle_max stay, a collect file connects nothing); a ready task also waits while an open job branch changes one of its files
